items.title: Welcome Muse Spark Open: open-weight frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model from Meta
items.summary: Hugging Face announced Muse Spark Open as a named Meta multimodal mixture-of-experts model offered with open weights. Access to model weights may expand deployment and evaluation options for teams comparing multimodal AI systems. Review its model card for actual weights, license restrictions, modalities, model size, context length, GPU needs and independently reproduced evaluations.
